usedFor: Webshipper holds the shipments, orders and returns, Dropbox receives files, and “Report Created” can start “Upload File to Dropbox”.

bestTemplate.name: “Report Created” in Webshipper, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: The action saves a file from a public web link into a chosen Dropbox folder.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” needs a public link and can add, replace or update a file, so check that choice.
